caseName: Nat'l Labor Relations Bd. v. Gestamp S.C. LLC.
caseNameFull: NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS BOARD v. GESTAMP SOUTH CAROLINA LLC.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit for further consideration in light of NLRB v. Noel Canning, 573 U.S. ----, 134 S.Ct. 2550, --- L.Ed.2d ---- (2014).
